VALIDATION_ERROR.title: Validation error
VALIDATION_ERROR.description: Check the entered data and try again.

ARTIST_NOT_FOUND.title: Artist not found
ARTIST_NOT_FOUND.description: Try another name or check the spelling.

ALBUM_NOT_FOUND.title: Album not found
ALBUM_NOT_FOUND.description: The requested album does not exist or is not available.

NO_EDITIONS_FOUND.title: No editions available
NO_EDITIONS_FOUND.description: No ingestible editions were found for this album.

RECORDING_NOT_FOUND.title: Recording not found
RECORDING_NOT_FOUND.description: The requested recording does not exist or is unavailable.

AUTH_REQUIRED.title: Sign-in required
AUTH_REQUIRED.description: Sign in to perform this action.

INVALID_CREDENTIALS.title: Invalid credentials
INVALID_CREDENTIALS.description: The username, email, or password is incorrect.

EMAIL_TAKEN.title: Email already registered
EMAIL_TAKEN.description: Use another email or sign in.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Too many attempts
RATE_LIMITED.description: Wait a few minutes before trying again.

PERMISSION_DENIED.title: Action not allowed
PERMISSION_DENIED.description: You do not have permission to modify this resource.

INVALID_TARGET.title: Invalid target
INVALID_TARGET.description: The selected resource is not valid.

INTERNAL_ERROR.title: Unexpected error
INTERNAL_ERROR.description: We couldn't complete the request. Please try again in a moment.

OAUTH_CONFIG_MISSING.title: Google sign-in unavailable
OAUTH_CONFIG_MISSING.description: Google sign-in is not configured at this time.

OAUTH_STATE_INVALID.title: Authentication session expired
OAUTH_STATE_INVALID.description: The Google sign-in session expired. Please try again.

OAUTH_CANCELLED.title: Sign-in cancelled
OAUTH_CANCELLED.description: You cancelled the Google sign-in. You can try again whenever you want.

OAUTH_CALLBACK_INVALID.title: Sign-in error
OAUTH_CALLBACK_INVALID.description: We couldn't complete the Google sign-in. Please try again.

OAUTH_TOKEN_INVALID.title: Invalid Google token
OAUTH_TOKEN_INVALID.description: We couldn't verify your identity with Google. Please try again.

OAUTH_EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED.title: Google email not verified
OAUTH_EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED.description: Your Google email is not verified. Verify your email on Google and try again.

EMAIL_TAKEN_BY_LOCAL.title: An account with that email already exists
EMAIL_TAKEN_BY_LOCAL.description: You already have an account with that email. Sign in with your password to continue.

USER_NOT_FOUND.title: User not found
USER_NOT_FOUND.description: The requested user does not exist or is not available.

RELATION_INVALID.title: Invalid follow operation
RELATION_INVALID.description: This operation cannot be performed with your own profile.

REQUEST_NOT_FOUND.title: Request not found
REQUEST_NOT_FOUND.description: The request does not exist or was already resolved.

BLOCKED.title: Blocked account
BLOCKED.description: You cannot perform this action with this account.
